official.line: Global Furry Television ge rasmee vebsaiteh
official.domain-heading: GFTV ge rasmee saitthah nimenee globalfurry.tv nuvatha gftv.asia in
official.domain-body: Edres kiyavaanee fahathun, furathama anna ekani slaishge kurin onna enme fahu thikin. Ehen ehchakun nimey saitakee GFTV ge saiteh noon, edresge kureegai nan fenunas.
official.trusted-link: GFTV ge rasmee saitthakuge furihama listu
official.secure-body: Thalhuge nishaan ballavaa, nuvatha edres fashanee https in kan ballavaa, misaalakah https://hello.globalfurry.tv. Zaathee maaloomaathu hissaakuravvaanee rakkaatheri kanekshaneh ge thereyin, rasmee saiteh gai ekani.
update.label: Apdeit
update.ready: GFTV HelloSpot ge au varshaneh thaiyyaaruveijje.
hero.card-alt: HelloSpot ge namuge kaadu. Eygai bodu hinithunvumehge kaireegai Hello aai 哈喽 liyefaivey, GFTV ge vihafath kulathakuge ronguthakuge matheegai.
hero.title: Thibaa ah HelloSpot eh feniijje!
hero.lede: Furry baiydhaluvunthakaai konvenshanthakugai, HelloSpot akee au meehun au rahumaiytherin hoadhaa thaneve.
how.title: HelloSpot eh masakkaiykuraa goi
how.spot.title: Hinithunvun hoadhdhavaa
how.spot.body: Kaadeh, leniyaadeh nuvatha saineh gai HelloSmile hoadhdhavaa. E huree konthaaku namavves, eyee HelloSpot ekeve.
how.hello.title: Halo bunuvvaa
how.hello.body: Kairiah vadaigen hai bunuvvaa. Thibaa adhi meehaku dhannaane kamah HelloSpot eh gai ehves meehaku ummeedheh nukuraane.
how.friend.title: Rahumaiyttheriaku hoadhdhavaa
how.friend.body: Vashaigen thibi meehunnaa baiydhalukuravvaa, adhi dhaairu, anna baiydhaluvumugai hoadhaane meehaku libifai hunnaane.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) akee Singapooru gai hunna, Eyshiyaage enme bodu furry fendamge khabaru chenaleve.
about.body-2: Fareenge kurierun miadhaai maadhamaa hurihaa meehakah gadharukureveyne gothah dhakkameve. Adhi meehunnah ekaku anekakaa behey gothun dhaskoh, ekaku anekaku visnumah jaaga fahikohdhemeve.
about.body-3: Geyin feshigen bodethi bahruthakah fethurifaivaa GFTV ge teemakee bainalaqvaamee, gina sagaafaiythakaai gina basthakuge teemekeve.
